method.inclusive_definition: Each sample contributes its weight once to every distinct source-backed production symbol present in its backtrace.
method.leaf_definition: A sample contributes leaf weight only when backtrace frame zero is a source-backed production symbol.
method.memory_stack_definition: A stack is counted when frame zero matches the explicit memory-copy, allocator/release, or array-storage classifier in this script; it is grouped by the nearest source-backed production frame.
method.production_symbol_definition: A frame from Mirmir.debug.dylib with a source path under the repository Mirmir directory.
method.product_binary_symbol_definition: Any frame from Mirmir.debug.dylib or the Mirmir executable, including compiler-generated frames without a positive source line.
method.memory_stack_anywhere_definition: Overlapping sample sets whose backtraces contain a malloc-library frame, a move/copy primitive, a set/zero primitive, or a Swift allocation/deallocation primitive; union values are deduplicated by sample.
